crossRefs.note: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

crossRefs.note: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
crossRefs.keyword: in the absence of the multitude. or, without tumult

parallels.note: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

translations.web: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
translations.bsb: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.
translations.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
translations.asv: And he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
